answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 7766 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: During umrah, performing saee, i forget to do seven rounds, but i did only five round, my wife and my brother too for three umrahs unknowingly, we live in jeddah, it happend unknowingly, please tell me the kaffrah or it is forgiven done by unknowingly. Question: During umrah, performing saee, i forget to do seven rounds, but i did only five round, my wife and my brother too for three umrahs unknowingly, we live in jeddah, it happend unknowingly, please tell me the kaffrah or it is forgiven done by unknowingly. Answer ID: 7766 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1755/1659=D/1429) Going from Safa to Marwa is one round, and then going from Marwa to Safa is second round. Thus there are seven rounds in the Sa?i out of which first four rounds are fardh (obligatory) and last three rounds are wajib (necessary). If you, as per the ways mentioned above, have done only five rounds in one Sai, so two rounds of each was left. Your Sai is valid, but in return of the every missed round, you will have to give sadqah of 1.633 kg wheat or its price. Each of you should pay the expiation of every two rounds of each Umrah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
